request.style: English, contemporary gospel, powerful male lead with gospel choir call and response, Hammond organ, piano, slap bass, drums, hand claps, driving and joyful, 98 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
An expert in the law stood up to test him in the crowd
Teacher, which is the greatest commandment, he asked aloud
Jesus did not hesitate, his answer came out plain
He gave them back the ancient words they'd heard and heard again

[Chorus]
You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart
With all your soul, and with all your mind
This is the great and first commandment
And the second is like it
You shall love your neighbor as yourself

[Verse]
Love him when you're rising and love him when you rest
Love him with your thinking and the heart within your chest
And the one who lives beside you and the stranger at your door
Love them like you love yourself, that's what the law is for

[Chorus]
You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart
With all your soul, and with all your mind
This is the great and first commandment
And the second is like it
You shall love your neighbor as yourself

[Bridge]
On these two commandments hang the whole law and the prophets
With all your heart
With all your soul
With all your mind

[Outro]
You shall love your neighbor as yourself
With all your heart
